'''Football Club Jonava''', previously (1996–2016) known as '''Football Club Lietava''', is a Lithuanian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Jonava]]. The club gained promotion to the [[A lyga]] as champions of the [[I Lyga]] in [[2015 LFF I lyga|2015]], but were relegated from [[A Lyga]] in 2018."}}
